cardDesc: Architecture-first data engineering project: 3NF schema, ETL quality controls, validation framework, and automated reporting pipeline.
title: Database Design for Restaurant Analytics
overview: End-to-end restaurant analytics database pipeline emphasizing design and reliability: 3NF modeling, MySQL integrity constraints, ETL cleaning/deduplication, source-vs-DB validation checks, stored procedures, and RMarkdown reporting. Includes historical snapshot metrics from past data runs.
details: 3NF schema design with PK/FK relationships and integrity constraints
ETL pipeline for cleaning sentinel values, normalizing entities, and customer deduplication
Validation framework for row-count and financial aggregate reconciliation
Stored procedures for operational inserts and missing-entity handling
